messages:
Lena (Partnerships): idea: a 'commit ladder' private offer to help customers shift from metered to committed spend. combine an initial hardware-credit token + usage bands that unlock higher discounts at renewal. low admin overhead is key.
Marco (Marketplace): can you outline the ladder levels?
Lena (Partnerships): level A (0-3m): onboarding credits (BYOH token up to $X), level B (3-12m): mid discount for hitting 60% of band, level C (12-24m): full committed discount + renewal smoothing.
Ivy (Sales Ops): questions: how do we show progress in the console? and what's the math for mid-term conversions?
Lena (Partnerships): progress bar in partner dashboard; conversions apply immediately, credit prorated for remaining months.
Sam (Legal): need guardrails: credit expiration (12 months), anti-fraud clause (no synthetic replay), and limits on stacking with other promos.
Ravi (SI): we need partner-specific SKUs and a usage webhook so SIs can push verified consumption for conversion triggers. also request a 45-day co-marketing window post-activation.
Lena (Partnerships): agreed on partner-SKU + webhook. 45-day co-marketing window OK.
marketplace-bot: draft private offer created: https://marketplace.internal/po/CL-4567 (internal)
Marco (Marketplace): discount suggestions? proposing 12% / 20% / 28% for A/B/C. include 30-day grace if usage dips below floor at renewal.
Ivy (Sales Ops): add churn protection: if usage <70% of committed for two months after renewal, auto-reprice to floor and notify partner 14 days prior.
Sam (Legal): will draft terms for grace, repricing, and credit expiration. flag: ensure marketplace listing complies with partner marketplace policies.
Ravi (SI): can partnerships team own the enablement doc? we need a sample invoice flow for partners.
Lena (Partnerships): yes, I'll own enablement + template invoice flow. next steps: legal draft, product implement partner-SKU and progress UI, billing implement prorated credit logic, partnerships ship enablement. I'll create a shared doc and schedule a 25-min sync Wed.
Ivy (Sales Ops): pls drop doc link here when up.
Lena (Partnerships): will do. thanks all. :tada:
